strings.jp:
焔帝!　神に代わって
その野望、打ち砕いてみせる!
strings.en:
Flame Emperor! For God, I
shall crush your ambition!

strings.jp:
雑魚が…死に急ぐのなら
望みを叶えてやる!
strings.en:
Small fry... If you're so eager
to die, I'll grant your wish!

strings.jp:
神殿騎士の力…
思い知ったか!
strings.en:
Now you know the
power of a Temple Knight!

strings.jp:
こんな雑魚…ごときに……
ぐはぁっ……!
strings.en:
To such small fry...
of all people... Gwaagh...!

strings.jp:
何だとッ……!?
神殿騎士ごときに…
strings.en:
What...!?
By a mere Temple Knight...

strings.jp:
神は全てを見ておいでだ!
降伏しろ!

か、神よ…
申し訳ございません……
strings.en:
O-O God...
I am so sorry......

strings.jp: 雑魚に用は無いと言ったはずだ!
strings.en:
I told you I have
no use for small fry!
